explication: sem is semantic version control layered on Git: it extracts code entities and relationships, indexes them, then exposes semantic queries, change-impact analysis, checks, diffs, and review certificates. The primary workflow runs through the CLI; MCP and Pi integrations expose related capabilities to agents, while Pi also supports guarded entity-level edits. The graph preserves README capabilities and the major indexed modules. Some subsystems are represented at their enclosing directory because their implementation files were not excerpted; links are limited to documented or indexed references.
